text.이 PC의 에이전트 로그를 모아 검색하고 대시보드로 본다: Collects agent logs on this PC so you can search them and view dashboards
text.세션 제목으로 쓸 이벤트를 고르는 규칙 하나입니다. 위 규칙부터 먼저 봅: One rule that picks the event to use as the session title. Rules higher in the list are checked first.
Tag of candidate events (added by the classifier).
Change this to use a different kind of event as the title.
If there are several candidates, the first (first) or last (last) by time.
Log collection interval, budget, retention and index location (server administrator values).
Background collection interval (seconds). 0 turns off background collection (manual [Collect now] only).
Change this when new logs show up late or to reduce disk reads.
Collects once right after the server starts (set separately from the interval).
text.출처 하나를 한 번 수집할 때 읽는 최대 바이트. 남은 것은 다음 수집에: Maximum bytes read from one source per collection. The rest is read in the next collection.
Number of events written to the index in one batch.
text.이보다 오래된 색인 이벤트를 지운다(원본 파일은 건드리지 않는다). 비우: Deletes indexed events older than this (original files aren't touched). Leave empty to keep them forever.
Lower this when the index file grows too large.
text.색인을 둘 별도 SQLite 파일. 비우면 서버 DB를 쓴다. 상대 경로: Separate SQLite file for the index. Leave empty to use the server database. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
text.이벤트 상세(detail·raw)를 응답에 실을 최대 크기(넘으면 잘림: Maximum size of event details (detail and raw) included in a response (above this, they're marked as truncated).
Number of events loaded into a session timeline at once (above this, only the first events).
text.대시보드 템플릿 폴더(*.yaml·*.json, 파일 하나 = 대시보드: Dashboard template folder (*.yaml and *.json, one file = one dashboard). Leave empty to use the default templates. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Maximum number of events in an archive download. Above this, only the first events are included.
Upper limit on the total size of events in an archive. Above this, only the first events are included.
Beginning of the archive download file name (letters, digits, . _ -).
Title shown at the top of the archive HTML file.
Rules that pick the session title (checked from the top; the first rule with a candidate wins). Leave empty to use the default rules; an empty list means no title.
text.기본 로그 분류로 쓸 YAML 파일. 비우면 패키지 기본, false나: YAML file to use as the default log classification. Leave empty to use the package default; false or an empty string means no default classification. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Use this to replace or turn off the package's default classification entirely.

codes.logs.ignored_key: Log source {source} setting {key} is no longer read. You can remove it from the settings.
codes.logs.out_of_scope: Skipped {skipped} project records in the root folder of log source {source} because those projects aren't registered.
codes.logs.purge_unsupported: This log index ({index}) doesn't support purging.
